lines.text: Ethan will sing of the LORD's loving devotion forever, and the LORD swore that David's offspring would endure.
The LORD stills the raging sea, crushed Rahab, and made north and south, and Sinai and Hermon shout for joy.
The LORD anointed David with sacred oil and promised to set his hand over the sea and the rivers.
If David's sons forsake the law, the LORD will use the rod, and He has sworn by His kingdom.
The LORD has cast the king's throne to the ground, and Ethan asks how long He will hide.
